title: Marcos tells ASEAN-UN panel: ‘Renewed political will’ needed; only 36% of 2030 SDG targets ‘on track’

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday called for “renewed political will” and stronger private sector partnerships to help ASEAN and the United Nations (UN) achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), noting that only 36 percent of the targets set for 2030 are currently “on track.”
